title: CHS-H-1-52 CASCO - 1415 18th Avenue. Moline, IL

onscreen_lines.desc: Location: 2 - Exterior Trade: 15 - Roofing 4580 - TEAR OFF AND REROOF SHINGLES - 25.00 SQ Address deteriorated roof system. Three-tab roof with missing, deteriorating asphalt on Front and Rear porches, Dormer, and Main Structure Roofing. Roof decking has previously been sheeted with plywood. Remove roof to deck. Install and fasten sheathing to the structure in accordance with IRC Code. Install 15 lb felt, ice and dam shield underlayment where required, self-sealing, 25 Year laminated architectural shingle. Replace all flashing, including valleys and roof edge. Flash and counterflash chimneys. Kick-out flashing where flashing terminates at side walls. Color choice by owner. Vent as required by ICC code. Install shingle-over ridge vent. Clean and dispose of all exterior debris generated by roof tear-off and replacement. Complete all work in accordance with the current International Residential Building Code.
